api: getHeaderHeight, getGroupHeaderHeight, getFooterHeight after a header or footer content change (text, image, font, word wrap, renderer, Grid font, auto height, a column removed)
stock_behaviour: the heights measured when the last column or the first group was added stay: a taller header or footer is drawn clipped, a smaller one keeps the extra room; a group header is measured at the width it was last painted with (zero before the first paint)
our_behaviour: measured again once before the next use (coalesced: a change only marks the header or footer; the next paint or height query measures); a group header at its columns' width; a wrapping header counts its lines only with auto height
cause_stock_5d0bcbb9: GridColumn.java:670, 1339, 1436, 1462, 1536, 1569 and Item.setImage do not invalidate; Grid.java:8078 removeColumn, 9579 setFont, 10595 setAutoHeight do not measure; Grid.java:4533 group measured with SWT.DEFAULT
javadoc_or_rule: getHeaderHeight: "Returns the height of the column headers."; setAutoHeight: "resizes row heights and column header heights based on word-wrapped content"

api: setColumnOrder(int[]) with column groups

cause_stock_5d0bcbb9: Grid.java setColumnOrder: colsInGroup reaches 0 and the next column is consumed by the else branch
javadoc_or_rule: ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT documented only for orders that split a group
